open_points.other_text: - _record_delivery_failure: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one new transaction, read the delivery_id and write the failed outcome only through tx.email_deliveries(), and commit exactly once, returning that record; its guard MUST close its transaction exactly once, roll back on failure only while the transaction is still open, and re-raise the original failure unchanged, and it MUST NOT use a legacy transaction-level delivery method, call the provider, or change the challenge the record references.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must the PortalStore contract declare the transaction operations required by the note, or must the note stop requiring operations absent from the declared contract?

open_points.subject: deliver_email_message
open_points.other_text: - deliver_email_message: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction, insert the pending record only through tx.email_deliveries(), and commit it before the provider is called; it MUST then call the provider with no transaction open, and afterwards open one further transaction to read that delivery_id and write the accepted outcome only through tx.email_deliveries(), committing exactly once. Holding any transaction open across the provider call, and using a legacy transaction-level delivery method, are forbidden.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must the PortalStore contract declare the transaction operations required by the note, or must the note stop requiring operations absent from the declared contract?
